candidates.change_summary: Replace the comparison so unlockTime is set to the smaller of _unlockTime and block.timestamp (uses ?:_ reversed), changing resulting stored unlockTime after Put.

Remove the safety require that checks for overflow when adding msg.value to balance, allowing possible revert/overflow behavior to differ (though under solidity 0.8.0 this will cause automatic revert on overflow instead of explicit require).
Change assignment to add a fixed extra wei (1) to stored balance when depositing, causing observed balance after Put to be higher by 1 wei.
Change to set unlockTime always to block.timestamp, ignoring provided _unlockTime, altering the stored unlockTime after Put.

Swap the order of updating balance and emitting the log so LogFile receives the previous balance effect (log sees before-balance change) — changing observable ordering of state and external call in Put.

Change the conditional from requiring block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to allowing collection when block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime (inclusive), which can alter whether Collect succeeds at the unlock boundary.
Remove the MinSum check so users can Collect amounts even when their balance is below MinSum, changing when Collect succeeds.
Swap the order of state update and external call: perform the external call before decrementing acc.balance, making reentrancy possibly change Collect observable behavior.

Change the transfer mechanism: replace low-level call with revert-less send style that does not revert on failure (assigning the success boolean but not reverting), so failed sends no longer revert the whole Collect.
When call succeeds, do not log the Collect event (remove LogFile.AddMessage), changing the externally observable log history after Collect.
